assertions.assertion: Window-head trim is confined to central three-window assembly; it does not cross both sloping windboards.
assertions.date: 2014 label in operator article; photograph date not independently verified
assertions.geometry: Top bar width reduced 8.7 to 4.4 m; lower cornices retained.

assertions.assertion: Decorative radial fan is above/around roundel, with short collar/corbels below; no long red tripod connects central window heads to roundel.
assertions.geometry: Nine shallow radial gold members radius 0.58–1.04 m, short split collar, four hanging corbels. Exact count/scale are photo-guided simplifications, not survey measurements.

assertions.assertion: Register explicitly supports radial ornament incorporating collar beam/kingpost and carved windboard supports.
assertions.geometry: Retain simplified radial fan rather than deleting all ornament.

stateCaveat: Recorded Monumenten photo has unknown capture date and appears pre-restoration; use explicitly restored 2014 operator photo for current-state detail. Cached occii-front.jpg is colored historical illustration, not current photo.
preserved: All non-gold/non-red decoded material geometry unchanged within 5 mm compressed-export quantization; roof/footprint/suppression/route/pin/card untouched.

candidateRevision.correction: Retained high-relief red windboard bosses obscured two initial radial angles; redistributed upper fan spoke angles in same shallow supported plane, preserving bosses and roundel. Exact carved petal shape/angular spacing remain photo-guided approximation.
candidateRevision.checks: 243 fan first-hit probes across all nine spokes, three length fractions, three fractional-width positions, front and obliques matching independent rays pass; no material exemptions.

acceptance: Scoped local source/root/fresh independent/gallery/native repair accepted; public commit and hosted verification pending. Retained rear roof not newly certified.
